errorCodes.meaning: No open or recently accepted offer to this room is addressed to the caller.
The caller is not an active member of this community.
The room is `attributed` or `private`, and the request carries no KeyPackage.
The room is `open`, which has no group, and the request carries a KeyPackage.
The KeyPackage did not validate, or its leaf does not identify the caller.
The offer was accepted with a different KeyPackage, or so long ago that its Welcome is no longer kept. Ask the community to remove and re-admit.
The community's VTA did not answer, or the room's epoch advance is not yet known. Retry the identical request: the community settles the admission before answering again.
The community's VTA refused the admission. Its own code and message are carried in `details`.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: Success response to vtc/rooms/offers/accept. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/rooms/offers/accept/0.1#response. The caller is admitted; on a sealed tier, with the Welcome to deliver to their own key holder.

epoch.description: The room epoch the caller joins at.

ratchetTree.description: The group's ratchet tree, where the Welcome does not carry it. Passed to rooms/keys/welcome unchanged.

welcome.description: On a sealed tier, the MLS Welcome sealed to the caller's KeyPackage, for the caller to hand their own key holder with rooms/keys/welcome. Opens nothing for anyone else.

keyPackage.description: On an `attributed` or `private` room, the caller's MLS KeyPackage for this room, base64url without padding, as their key holder minted it with rooms/keys/key-package against the offer's invitation. Absent on an `open` room, which has no group.
